accepted_corpus.denominator_policy: For each paired event, intersect source-observed canonical DOIs with that event's predeclared chunk allowlist. Preserve every outside match in the source artifact and ledger.

comparison.design: paired complete source calls with predeclared canonical-DOI projection
comparison.source_rows: Anywhere DOI union AND Title exact-phrase union
comparison.multi_topic_union: union projected separately filtered canonical DOI sets offline

acceptance_checks: Every baseline retrieves every canonical DOI in its predeclared chunk allowlist.
Every projected Topic set is a subset of its paired projected baseline.
Every outside-allowlist source match remains retained and is reported separately.
Every typed Topic label visibly resolves to its predeclared numeric ConceptID.
Every source event remains at most 100 and is captured completely.
Every successful JSON has both mandatory sibling screenshots.
